step1_content:
`gThe Town Square is the vibrant heart of the realm.`w

Here you'll find all essential places:

• `yThe Bank`w: Safely store your gold against robbers and earn interest.
• `cInn & Herbalist`w: Restore your HP, meet travelers, or enjoy a treatment.
• `pChurch & Shrine`w: Make offerings for divine blessings.
• `2Shops & Stables`w: Purchase equipment, potions, and mounts.
step2_content:
`gThe Forest is where you train as an adventurer!`w

• Each search or battle costs `c1 Daily Turn`w.
• Defeat monsters to collect `yGold`w and `cExperience (XP)`w.
• Watch your HP: if you fall in battle, you are `4DEAD`w and lose all gold on hand!
step3_content:
`gWithout proper gear, you stand no chance against fierce monsters!`w

• Visit the `ySmithy`w in the town square.
• Buy powerful `yWeapons`w to deal higher damage.
• Buy sturdy `cArmor`w to reduce incoming damage.
• Upgrade your equipment as soon as you save up enough gold.
step4_content:
`gGathered enough XP in the forest?`w

• Head to the `pTraining Grounds`w in the Town Square.
• Challenge the Master to a test of your strength.
• Defeat the Master to `2Level Up`w!
• You'll increase Max HP, gain new capabilities, and unlock better equipment.
step5_content:
`gEvery new day brings fresh opportunities!`w

• Every 24 hours a `cNew Day`w reset takes place.
• You receive fresh forest turns and interest on banked gold.
• Keep fighting, saving, and training until you reach `yLevel 15`w.
• Prepare yourself for the final showdown against the legendary `4Golden Dragon`w!
